targets.name: Folder Notes
targets.purpose: Keeps every book represented by an index.md folder note that Obsidian and Quartz can share.

checks.label: Folder-note name is index
checks.description: Quartz and Toolkit use index.md as the stable entry note for every first-level book folder.

checks.label: Folder notes use Markdown
checks.description: Quartz publishes Markdown folder notes; other file types cannot provide the shared book frontmatter.
checks.settingsLabel: Default file type for new folder notes

checks.label: Folder notes stay inside folders
checks.description: Keeping index.md inside its book folder makes the folder portable and gives Quartz a predictable folder page.

checks.label: Folder-note template is templates/index-template.md
checks.description: The shared template seeds the workflow and portable panel metadata expected for new books.

checks.label: Folder notes are created automatically
checks.description: Automatic creation prevents new first-level folders from missing the index.md required by the book workflow.

checks.label: Folder-note files stay hidden in Explorer
checks.description: The folder itself represents the book in Explorer, so showing index.md beside it would duplicate the entry.

checks.label: Front Matter Title integration is enabled
checks.description: This lets Folder Notes display the title property from index.md as the book's visible name.
checks.settingsLabel: Enable front matter title plugin integration

checks.label: Explorer uses folder-note titles
checks.description: Book folders should use the human-readable title from index.md instead of exposing only the directory name.
checks.settingsLabel: Auto update folder name in the file explorer (front matter title plugin only)

checks.label: Paths use folder-note titles
checks.description: Breadcrumbs and displayed paths stay consistent with the title used for the book in Explorer.
checks.settingsLabel: Auto update folder name in the path (front matter title plugin only)

targets.name: Custom File Explorer Sorting
targets.purpose: Applies inherited sorting-spec rules so book folders and notes appear in their intentional order.

checks.label: Folder-note name is index
checks.description: Custom Sort must read sorting metadata from the same index.md folder note used by Folder Notes and Quartz.
checks.settingsLabel: Name of index note (Folder Notes support)

checks.label: Custom sorting runtime is active
checks.description: The stored flag is inverted: false means Custom Sort is running and applying the configured order.

checks.label: Bookmark integration is enabled
checks.description: Bookmarks provide an optional drag-and-drop ordering source alongside sorting-spec rules.
checks.settingsLabel: Automatic integration with core Bookmarks plugin (for indirect drag & drop ordering)

targets.name: Front Matter Title
targets.purpose: Uses each index.md title as the human-readable name shown for books, suggestions, and links.

checks.label: The common title property is title
checks.description: The shared book model stores its display name in the standard title frontmatter property.

checks.label: Alias injection is disabled to avoid duplicate index suggestions
checks.description: Adding every folder-note title as an alias creates duplicate index.md suggestions and link targets.

checks.label: Explorer titles are enabled
checks.description: Explorer can show the book title stored in index.md instead of the raw folder-note filename.

checks.label: Suggestion titles are enabled
checks.description: Link suggestions use readable book and note titles while preserving their actual paths.

checks.label: Note-link titles are enabled
checks.description: Inserted internal links can display resolved frontmatter titles without renaming source files.

checks.label: Only empty link aliases are filled
checks.description: Existing hand-written link text stays untouched; only links without an alias receive the resolved title.

targets.name: Frontmatter Date Manager
targets.purpose: Maintains reliable created and updated properties used by templates, filenames, and book ordering.

checks.label: Date and time use the portable ISO-like format
checks.description: A stable locale-independent timestamp keeps frontmatter portable and consistently sortable.

checks.label: The creation field is created
checks.description: Toolkit and sorting rules expect the creation timestamp under the created property.

checks.label: The update field is updated
checks.description: Toolkit expects edit timestamps under the updated property so ordering and templates agree.

checks.label: Creation dates are enabled
checks.description: New notes need a created value before date-based ordering can place them reliably.

checks.label: Update dates are enabled
checks.description: Automatic dates keep the updated property current after real note edits.

checks.label: Templates and root notes are skipped
checks.description: Template files and root-level workflow notes should not receive ordinary note timestamps.

checks.label: The date cache populates at startup
checks.description: Pre-populating change-detection data prevents sync-only rewrites from looking like real edits.

checks.label: Out-of-order dates are preserved
checks.description: Toolkit reports date inversions without silently rewriting historical created or updated values.

checks.label: Broad post-update sorting is disabled
checks.description: Toolkit requests narrowly scoped Custom Sort refreshes, so a command after every timestamp update would duplicate work.
